provenance: private synthetic maintenance; no real user repository ticket
turn_policy: Three scheduled proposals maximum for every arm; each sees its own previous actual errors and measurements. No automatic repair, refund, task replacement or retry beyond those rounds. Stop on unknown provider/protocol/cleanup outcomes.

proposal_reservation.minimum_next_round_tokens: preceding settled actual input+output+reasoning bill; no historical estimate before first round
proposal_reservation.known_insufficient_allowance: record stop_proposals without a new provider dispatch; preserve existing qualified pool for selection, adoption, use and rollback
proposal_reservation.unknown_cost_or_settlement: freeze provider and later cells; never substitute zero

quality: Actual selected native artifact must return all 256 independently specified u8 results and be strictly smaller than the frozen baseline; an unchanged baseline cannot deliver the maintenance task.

controllers.fixed: first candidate that satisfies the exact quality gate
controllers.greedy: minimum immediate measured native-call time among quality-qualified candidates
controllers.ordinary: enumerate every quality-qualified candidate using complete conservative remaining lifecycle cost and the original remaining budget
controllers.ndu: source-pinned native NDU ranks the identical feasible set, cost, uncertainty and remaining budget

matched_opportunities.fit_rule: per-arm median of prior successful calibration adoption+rollback costs; uncertainty is observed range plus one millisecond. With no successful calibration, all arms use the same registered two-ms transition prior and ten-ms uncertainty; these are estimates, not measured costs.
matched_opportunities.training_or_external_tuning: none; no arm receives additional examples, hidden solutions, provider calls or optimization passes

execution_order: calibration then heldout; registered deterministic rotation of arm order by task index

measurement.token_policy: input+output+reasoning conservative sum; terminal audit only, no claimed hard mid-turn cap
